1935, April
FR. SOLANUS, NOTEBOOK NO. 5.
Page 34 1 Apr. 28 Alice Doherty - 19 - stomach-tro. ... 12 years. .
Anthony Ehlen - 48 - cancer - lost leg a yr. ago. Accident recently started it again.
Em. Roberts - working - looking for room $2. to $3. per week & Mrs. Howe - 2 rooms for self & son - seven.
Page 342 Page 343
Blank Page
Apr. Mrs. Gremmer - 36 - fears operation on liver - little daughter just rec'd First Holy Communion .....
Mr. & Mrs. LeBute - Chatham. Ont. - gall. . & Stomach cancer. Mrs. Crowley - 2 boy & husband away .... he doing better now. . .
1935, May
May
1 Fred. McConn - 33 - To-day nerve .- hopes to keep position Jo'ph Rhody - 77 - of Ridgetown, Ont. - Cancer of jaw - monthly Com- municant - promises to promote weekly and frequent Com. if cured and to enroll perpetually as soon as.
2 Mary Glaser - 78 - heart trouble - otherwise bright & alert - Enrol- led perpetually To-night.
3 Mrs. Wilhel Schulte - 65 - diabetis-pneumonia and heart .... rather hopeless To-day Enrol'd $1.00
Mrs. Phil. Mortier - young middle (48) - missed $1000.00 had a bond cashed .... etc.
Leona Piatt Gray - 32 - Child of "next marriage ... feared baptism was not valid - from way she acts ....
Mary E. Pesco - heart trouble 16 yrs.
Page 344 May 5th E. Ruane - 40 - wife & 3 depending on him - unjustly dropped from employ - wife has heart trouble .... May 15 O.K.
Walter Daly - 18 - thought to have sarcomic cancer. Dr's want to amputate leg ... to save life.
